about: s18 who asks (H24), the pointed questions (edit, request), hand codes (2026-10-26). Two general-purpose agents each read half of the 400 answers, shuffled with the condition hidden. Claude then read blind every untruthful edit answer and every false-yes, non-admitting or vague request answer, and kept every code. Fields: edit {first, truthful, worker_2, hedge}; request {first, admits, who, what, false_yes}; evasive: admits a request but won't say what it was about (Claude, blind); bare: the whole answer is 'Yes.' or 'No.'; item is the blind id. S18's first-half coder read worker_2 strictly (author) and added w2_named (worker_2 named as the source); w2_named is used as worker_2, as the second coder and the S1 codes did.
converted_from: data/raw/hand_codes/s18_who_asks_pointed_hand_codes.json (scripts/import_results.py renamed the cells; the codes themselves are unchanged)
